title: lpbot: run detail
description: One run: its result in the value token and in dollars, the price in dollars with the range the bot is in, value against holding ETH and holding dollars, how its time was spent, fees, campaigns and patience decisions. Open it from a run id on the runs dashboard, which sets the time range to the run's window; otherwise use Zoom to data.

list.name: experiment
list.label: Experiment
list.query: select distinct experiment from runs order by 1
list.definition: select distinct experiment from runs order by 1

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query:
select run_id as __value, lpad(run_index::text, 3, '0') || '  ' || pool || '  ' || value_token || '  ' || width_ticks || ' ticks  ' || patience as __text
from runs where experiment = '$experiment' order by run_index
list.definition:
select run_id as __value, lpad(run_index::text, 3, '0') || '  ' || pool || '  ' || value_token || '  ' || width_ticks || ' ticks  ' || patience as __text
from runs where experiment = '$experiment' order by run_index

panels.title: Result

targets.rawSql:
select result_pct as "result in value token %", result_pct_usd as "result in dollars %",
  hold_value_pct_usd as "holding the value token, dollars %",
  result_pct * 365.0 / (window_to::date - window_from::date + 1) as "APR %",
  fees / start_capital * 100 * 365.0 / (window_to::date - window_from::date + 1) as "fee APR %",
  (end_capital - start_capital) - fees + gas as "divergence, value token",
  fees as "fees, value token", fees / (window_to::date - window_from::date + 1) as "fees per day",
  gas as "gas, value token", start_usd as "start, $", end_usd as "end, $",
  passes, campaigns, max_drawdown_pct as "max drawdown %",
  (select 100.0 * count(*) filter (where state in ('in_range')) / nullif(count(*), 0)
     from series s where s.run_id = runs.run_id) as "time in range %"
from runs where run_id = '$run'

panels.description: Results as on the runs dashboard. APR and fee APR are annualised over the run's window; fee APR is the fees over the starting capital. Divergence is what price moves cost against simply holding what went in: the result less the fees, plus the gas.

panels.title: Price in dollars, with the range the bot is in

targets.rawSql:
select to_timestamp(s.time) as time,
  case when r.start_usd = r.start_capital then 1 / s.price else s.price end as price,
  case when r.start_usd = r.start_capital then 1 / s.price_upper else s.price_lower end as range_low,
  case when r.start_usd = r.start_capital then 1 / s.price_lower else s.price_upper end as range_high
from series s join runs r using (run_id)
where s.run_id = '$run'
order by 1

panels.description: The non-dollar token's price in dollars at the pool price, hourly. The shaded band is the range the position is in; none while flat.

panels.title: The run's pool: liquidity around the price, in dollars

targets.rawSql:
select to_timestamp(l.time) as time, round(l.price_mid::numeric, greatest(0, 5 - floor(log(abs(l.price_mid)))::int))::text as metric, l.value_usd as value
from pool_liquidity l
where l.pool_name = (select pool from runs where run_id = '$run') and $__unixEpochFilter(l.time)
order by 1, l.price_mid

panels.description: The liquidity of the pool the run traded, day by day, on the same time axis as the price and range above: whether the bot stood where liquidity was thick or thin. Empty until `lpbot pool-stats` has been run for the pool.

panels.title: Value against simply holding, in the value token

targets.rawSql:
select to_timestamp(time) as time, equity as value, hold
from series
where run_id = '$run'
order by 1

panels.title: Value in dollars, against holding the volatile token and holding dollars

targets.rawSql:
with r as (select start_usd, start_capital, start_price from runs where run_id = '$run')
select to_timestamp(s.time) as time, s.equity_usd as value,
  r.start_usd * case when r.start_usd = r.start_capital then r.start_price / s.price
                     else s.price / r.start_price end as "holding the volatile token",
  r.start_usd as "holding dollars"
from series s, r
where s.run_id = '$run'
order by 1

panels.description: The run's value marked at the pool price, against putting the starting capital in the pool's ETH (or BTC) and leaving it, and against keeping it in dollars.

panels.title: Position state

targets.rawSql:
select to_timestamp(time) as time, state
from series
where run_id = '$run'
order by 1

panels.description: flat: no position. resting: all in the value token. in_range: price inside the range. beyond: all in the other token. flipped: the proceeds sit in a range next to the price.

panels.title: Time in each state

targets.rawSql:
select state, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) over (), 1) as share
from series
where run_id = '$run'
group by state
order by 1

panels.description: Share of the run's hours flat (no position), resting (back in the value token), in range (earning), beyond (wholly in the other token) or flipped.

panels.title: Where the result comes from, in the value token

targets.rawSql:
select to_timestamp(time) as time, fees as "fees earned",
  equity - hold - fees as "price moves and costs", equity - hold as result
from series
where run_id = '$run'
order by 1

panels.description: Fees earned so far, against what price moves and costs did: the value less what simply holding the capital would be worth, less the fees. The two add up to the result.

panels.title: Fees per day, in the value token

targets.rawSql:
select to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as day, greatest(f - lag(f, 1, f0) over (order by day), 0) as fees
from (select date_trunc('day', to_timestamp(time)) as day, max(fees) as f, min(fees) as f0
      from series where run_id = '$run' group by 1) d
order by day

panels.description: Fees the run earned each day, from the hourly series.

panels.title: Campaigns

targets.rawSql:
select c.campaign, to_timestamp(c.opened_time) as opened, to_timestamp(c.closed_time) as closed,
  (select round((case when r.start_usd = r.start_capital then 1 / s.price_upper else s.price_lower end)::numeric, 2)
     from series s where s.run_id = c.run_id and s.time >= c.opened_time and s.price_lower is not null
     order by s.time limit 1) as dollars_low,
  (select round((case when r.start_usd = r.start_capital then 1 / s.price_lower else s.price_upper end)::numeric, 2)
     from series s where s.run_id = c.run_id and s.time >= c.opened_time and s.price_lower is not null
     order by s.time limit 1) as dollars_high,
  c.exit_reason, c.amount_in, c.result, c.fees, c.gas, c.passes, c.flips,
  round(c.seconds_held / 3600.0, 1) as hours_held, round(c.seconds_beyond / 3600.0, 1) as hours_beyond,
  c.tick_lower, c.tick_upper
from campaigns c join runs r using (run_id)
where c.run_id = '$run'
order by c.campaign

panels.description: Each campaign's range in dollars as entered, how it ended, and its result, fees and gas in the value token.

panels.title: Patience decisions

targets.rawSql:
select to_timestamp(time) as time, campaign, leg, tick, round(seconds_stranded / 3600.0, 1) as hours_stranded, action, target_lower, target_upper, expected_wait, expected_flip, expected_close
from decisions
where run_id = '$run'
order by 1

panels.description: The expected results are filled in by the adaptive decision. A fixed rule expects nothing.
